idea: A quiet snowy garden: a tap sends a small walker trudging through the snow, footprints fill in slowly, and a fox crosses if you stand still.
verdict: 10 Nov: liked it, and asked for more interaction. Added a drag that draws a groove in the snow, a tap on the tree that shakes snow off and moves the bird to the gate, a long press that rolls a snowball into a snowman (three at most, tap one to topple it), and a swipe across the sky that thickens the fall for a few seconds. Pending re-review.
